rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: GridStamp provides cryptographic spatial receipts for drones, robots, AGVs, and autonomous vehicles, enabling verifiable proof-of-presence at specific locations and times. The MCP server exposes GridStamp's verification and stamping tools, allowing AI agents to generate, verify, and audit location proofs with 91% GPS spoofing detection. It is part of the MnemoPay SDK for autonomous agent economic infrastructure.
